title: Console Refresh form omits required confirmation
description: Evidence: apps/console/src/app/app.tsx posts /api/commands/sync.refresh without confirm=yes; apps/console/src/app/commands.ts marks sync.refresh requiresConfirmation=true; apps/console/src/server.ts rejects unconfirmed commands with CONSOLE_COMMAND_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED. Impact: the top-bar Refresh button cannot refresh projections.
acceptanceCriteria: Refresh action submits the required confirmation token/field or uses a non-confirming safe command path, and a console test covers the POST success path.
